name: Consecrated Horned Crocodile
storytext: A reptile that has mutated after feeding from greater lifeforms, controlling the ever-changing flow of water.
source: Reward for accepting the Tavern Challenge at The Cat's Tail and claiming victory in a Friendly Fracas with the Consecrated Horned Crocodile
